# check/todo

> Not written yet: todo stops the program here.

truck [check](../check.md) · [source](../../../registry/check/todo.pkg)

```
fn export_pdf(doc: ptr Doc)
  todo "PDF export"
end
```

Writes the position and any messages to stderr and exits with status 2:

```
app.pkg:2:3: not implemented yet: PDF export
```

`todo` alone has no message; with messages (`str` expressions, separated
by commas) it is [check/todo_msg](todo_msg.md). It is not turned off by
`nocheck`.

## Syntax

Kind: `statement`

```
todo
```
